definition: Guarani per US dollar, monthly average of the fluctuating-market quotation.
proposal_evidence: exchange_rates 'USD Prom' is titled 'Estudios Economicos - COTIZACION DEL DOLAR AMERICANO - Promedio Mensual', which states both the currency pair and the monthly-average timing basis.
proposed_by: claude-opus-5, drafted from published worksheet titles and column labels
open_questions: The concept covers 1989 onward only, and deliberately has one member. The 1945-1969 annual history on 'USD Fin Mes' is a different regime (regime:pyg_usd:pre_float) and is excluded rather than spliced. CUADRO 60a's monthly USD column was drafted as an alias and withdrawn: over the 355 months both publish, it is closest to the selling rate (mean difference -3.85 guaranies) but is not equal to it, and it sits well away from the buying rate (+58.87) and the midpoint (+27.51). Two published monthly PYG/USD series that differ by a few guaranies are not the same figure, so the audit's ER-11 failure response applies -- keep the sources separate -- until the BCP's note says which market and which side of the quote CUADRO 60a reports.

The two carry the SAME series identity hash (6929f799551947bd2eb72b88) and are identical on unit, scale, frequency and coverage, so the title is the only field that separates them -- which is the audit's section 4 finding, and is why table_title is now published.
